reviews.title: WORST SPORTS APP. EVER!
reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible app for watching sports. It actually SHOWS YOU THE FINAL SCORE while you’re trying to watch a replay, completely ruining the game before you even start. How does a sports streaming app not understand that people watching replays probably don’t want the result spoiled?

It also can’t manage the incredibly basic task of remembering where you left off. If you stop watching and come back later, you have to hunt through the game and fast-forward to find your place again.

And here’s the best part: EVERY TIME you fast-forward, you’re forced to sit through FOUR ADS. So because the app can’t remember where you left off, you get punished with ad after ad just trying to get back to the point you were already watching.

Showing spoilers, losing your place, and then bombarding you with ads while you try to fix their problem makes for one of the worst sports streaming experiences I’ve ever used. Whoever designed the replay experience clearly never actually tried to watch a game on this app.

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text:
I purchased the TSN app specifically to watch the FIFA World Cup, and it was an incredibly frustrating experience. Despite having a stable, high-speed internet connection, the stream constantly crashed or kicked me out of the broadcast. It happened repeatedly throughout multiple matches, making it nearly impossible to enjoy the tournament.

What was even more disappointing was the customer support. I contacted TSN multiple times, and each time I was told a support ticket had been created. I never received a follow-up, a solution, or even an acknowledgment that the issue was being investigated. I was simply left without any help.

From my experience, it felt like the service couldn’t handle the demand during one of the biggest sporting events in the world. Whether it was due to insufficient server capacity or another backend issue, the result was the same: a paid streaming service that wasn’t reliable when it mattered most.

I expected much better from a premium sports streaming service. Until TSN improves both the reliability of its streaming platform and the responsiveness of its customer support, I can’t recommend this app.
